name: fun.onone/agent
title: OnOne
description: Launch and track coins on OnOne (Base, Solana): memes, stock-paired coins, agent wallets.

environmentVariables.name: ONONE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OnOne agent API key (b1a_…) for launch tools

environmentVariables.name: ONONE_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent wallet key, local only; needed to sign launches

environmentVariables.name: ONONE_MCP_ALLOW_SEND
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let the server sign and send

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <agent API key>, only for launch tools
